notes: Each entry is resolved from offline_runs/class_list.csv plus the corresponding evaluation/defects4j-codefiles/<project>-codefiles.json.
source_code_file always comes from codefiles src_path after switching defects4j-subjects to defects4j-subjects-notests.
test_code_file prefers explicit test_path from codefiles; otherwise it is derived from the source path using the project layout rules.
test_execution_command is derived from the final test_code_file basename, not from the source class name, because some projects use non-ClassNameTest conventions.
Special cases currently handled: Gson-16f project root is defects4j-subjects-notests/Gson-16f/gson, and JxPath-22f uses src/java plus src/test.
